title: Monodromy defects in Chern-Simons theory and Holography
summary: Wilson loop operators in Chern-Simons theory have revealed profound links between quantum field theory, the fractional quantum Hall effect, topology, conformal field theory, and string theory. In Chern-Simons theories with charge conjugation symmetry, we construct a new class of observables: codimension-two monodromy defects around which fields return to themselves up to charge conjugation. Whereas Wilson loops are labeled by integrable representations of an untwisted affine Lie algebra, monodromy defects are labeled by those of the corresponding twisted affine algebra.
